prepared_runtime.boundary: Prepared receipt is a prior immutable snapshot. This review makes no claim about current root-owned UI/process state and performed no launch or UI input.

protocol.action: Use one fresh isolated original process for each case from the prepared seven-case root. Preserve all earlier calibration captures; do not continue a prior C3 calibration as C0.
Use the real toolbar Pause, then toolbar Load exact input.sim. Verify the saved/input native tail counter is C0 and UserSeed48032. Do not start a new simulation or use menuLoad/FindBest.
Verify PlayerBot is OFF through the actual UI. Keep Details and Gene Activations windows closed. Select one real bot once at C0 with a plain click and no movement while a button is held.
Open the real enabled Open Console route(Ctrl+Y). Use lowercase single-space commands in its command textbox; do not use debug,execrob,energy,set,play or settings changes.

Submit cycle1 as text `cycle 1` then Enter. Wait for the textbox to clear after synchronous command completion. Save to a new C1 capture through the real save route; decode actual savedcounter1 and seed48032 before labeling it C1.
Submit `cycle 9`, wait for textbox clear, save a new C10 capture, and validate actualcounter10/seed48032.

Submit `cycle 90`, wait for textbox clear, save a new C100 capture, and validate actualcounter100/seed48032. If a console command is ignored because its target console reference vanished, preserve the attempt and use actual savedcounter; never infer advancement solely from requested count.

Record the chosen selector/C0/inputhashes/console1-9-90 protocol and actual saved counters. Preserve screenshots/logs as observation evidence, without replacing actual savecounter validation. A10-90 branch is also source-valid when intentionally beginning atC0 and onlyC10/C100 are needed; label that branch explicitly.

source_anchors.rule: Ctrl+Y invokes Open Console, but DisableRobotsMenu sets cons.Enabled=False without a selected bot; no forced slot0 invocation is part of this protocol.
Toolbar stop explicitly clears DisplayActivations and Form1.Active, disables SecTimer, sets pausefix. Toolbar singlecycle invokes Consoleform.cycle1.
Console is attached to the selected slot. Its documented cycleN command invokes the same cycle routine, performing exactlyN UpdateSim+Redraw calls with DoEvents.10/90 fit the Integer loop count.
Text2 clears only after Parse and the synchronous event.fire call returns; clear command text is a useful completion indication.
cevent.fire directly RaiseEvents textentered; it does not queue an independent simulation batch.
Visible cyclecaption is updated only when Int(Timer) changes; it can lag actual simulationcounter.

Hit selection temporarily subtracts then restores velocity-minus-actvel. Root-framed C0 inputs have both vectorszero and integerpositions, so that arithmetic is exact. Held-button MouseMove can instead move bots and zero velocity; ordinary MouseUp clears dragging.
Focus/console allocates/populates only ga() activation diagnostics. ExecRobs still executes all eligible living noncorpse/non-disabled actors; DisplayActivations is read only for console text output.

UpdateSim increments originalcycle and executes all bots. The actual focus-dependent gameplay branch is PlayerBot: when enabled it overwrites selected/highlighted bot memory. This is why PlayerBotOFF is semantically necessary.
Focus-only eyeDistance is a displaycache. Its possible main.frm1044-1045 display read is commented; it is not a VM memory/resource input.

Focus can mark offspring highlight and clear/move focus on death. Highlight is gameplay-relevant only under PlayerBot control; console death text/focus bookkeeping does not change birth fees/population/energy.
exechighlight only draws the activation grid; it does not execute DNA again.

Selected robfocus can supply DNA length for explicit mutation-editor/default-loading normalization. That path is not invoked merely by these console cycle commands; avoid editor commands in the capture protocol.
SaveRobotBody emits no robot console object,ga() activationarray or robot highlight field. The .highlight serialization elsewhere in this file belongs to teleporters.

semantic_effects.display_activations: Console cycle sets True for printing activation lines and resets False afterward. All other source references set/reset the flag; no read changes RNG,resources,reproduction or population.
semantic_effects.focus: Changes diagnostic activation tracking, eye-viewer cache, selection/rendering and child highlight. PlayerBotOFF prevents the actual focused-memory override. Explicit mutation-editor commands are outside protocol.
semantic_effects.selection_c0: The prepared exact input bytes were independently rehashed by this reviewer; zero-velocity/actvel and integerposition framing was performed by root and is declared in its prepared receipt. No engine was run to establish these facts.
semantic_effects.per_cycle_redraw: Toolbar singlecycle and console batches both call the same cycle routine with one Redraw per UpdateSim. This does not prove arbitrary GUI timing/history is bit-identical outside the declared projected-field comparisons.
semantic_effects.time_and_do_events: Console output and UI event pumping affect wall-clock/UI observations. DoEvents permits handling a save while a batch is still running, so command submission or a stale caption is not a sufficient counter proof.

explicit_limits: Static source review plus exact input raw-hash verification only; no executable,engine,CLI,test,parser,build,UI orGPU was run by the reviewer.
This authorizes a documented observation protocol, not a claim that a real command/capture succeeded. Actual saved nativecounter and seed remain authoritative.
Do not reuse or rename calibrationC3,old invalidC10 or any other observedcounter as a planned checkpoint.

Keep PlayerBotOFF,no held drag,noDetails,noNewSimulation,noFindBest/noediting,mode0/F1-off preparedinputs and freshprocess per case. These are protocol controls; no invented blanket ban on the original console is imposed.
The nativeSIM omits arbitrary historical Rnd/Gauss state. Fresh seed-controlled captures can support their exact compared fields; no arbitrary original trajectory or completedport claim follows.
No root-owned UI action is performed or duplicated by this review. No previous receipt,capture or frozen pin is modified.
